high_risk.name: Piment de Cayenne
high_risk.micro_report: ** Capsaicin, the active component, can cause irritation and inflammation of the mouth, esophagus, and stomach at high concentrations.  In rare cases, severe reactions may occur.  (Source:  Multiple scientific studies on capsaicin's effects)

moderate_risk.name: Crème aigre britannique
moderate_risk.micro_report: **  May contain high levels of saturated fat and sodium, contributing to cardiovascular issues if consumed excessively. Allergens like milk proteins are also possible. (Source:  Nutritional information on sour cream varies by brand)

moderate_risk.name: Sel
moderate_risk.micro_report: ** High sodium intake is linked to hypertension and increased risk of cardiovascular diseases.  Moderation is key. (Source:  Numerous studies on the effects of sodium on blood pressure)

moderate_risk.name: Sel fumé
moderate_risk.micro_report: ** Similar to regular salt, high consumption can lead to hypertension and related health problems. (Source:  Studies on sodium intake and health)

moderate_risk.name: Vinaigre de vin blanc
moderate_risk.micro_report: ** Contains sulfites, which can trigger allergic reactions in sensitive individuals. (Source:  Product label information)

moderate_risk.name: Concentré de tomate
moderate_risk.micro_report: **  High in sodium, potentially contributing to hypertension. (Source:  Nutritional information on tomato paste varies by brand)

moderate_risk.name: Épices moulues
moderate_risk.micro_report: **  Depending on the specific spices included, some may contain allergens or compounds that could cause adverse reactions in susceptible individuals. (Source:  Allergen information varies by spice)
